replication.target_description: Available replication tests weak acoustic prepulses at0,80,1000ms, rather than weak electrical prepulses at40–60ms in supplied description. Located overall Stimulus Type effect on subjective pain intensity, p.116.

n.sample_role: Participants in repeated-measures mixed ANOVA of pain intensity, all three SOA groups.
n.exclusions: From136 recruited,13 lost to equipment malfunction/experimenter error,3 terminated early,1 excluded for pain below10 in one block. Additional1 excluded only from unpleasantness, not pain intensity.

es.location: p.116 section2.3.1 Pain intensity ratings, PDF3
es.quote: The mean effect of Stimulus type repulse (F(1,95) = 4.76, p = .032)

p.quote: The mean effect of Stimulus type repulse (F(1,95) = 4.76, p = .032)

reported_success.quote: Failure to replicate previous ﬁndings of ... decreased pain by weak prepulses was most likely due to the sensory modality of the prepulse stimuli.

notes: Unassigned side not examined. Printed main effect F4.76,p.032 and n119 verified on rendered primary PDF2–3. This is an increase in pain, qualified by Stimulus Type×SOA interaction F(2,95)=6.25,p=.004. Target mismatch is modality/timing, not an unavailable paper; do not treat main-effect significance as replication success.
